evidence.observation: Thermocouple reads 750.0 °C at the 750 °C growth setpoint; the brief overshoot to 760.8 °C at t=2520 settled out.
Heater power holds steady at about 45% at the plateau, as expected once the ramp demand stops.
Argon flow is 100.0 sccm, matching the setpoint.
Pressure is stable near 3.03-3.06 Torr, with no sign of a leak or blockage.
Exhaust oxygen stays at 5-7 ppm; the purge worked.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet (for example Raman or microscopy) to show whether the target material grew. No reference statistics were provided to compare readings against.
